articles.title: Access the Ubuntu Desktop development environment from any device
articles.description: Connect securely to the Codefyhub Ubuntu Desktop graphical development environment from Windows, macOS, iOS, iPadOS, or Android.
prerequisites: Authorization from the Codefyhub DevOps Department
A connection to the Codefyhub office network or approved company VPN
The remote password retrieved from the approved Codefyhub secret channel
applicableVersions: RDP clients current at review date
